features.quote: Because the protocol deliberately induces and *prolongs* a negative-valence-typed state under genuine uncertainty about model moral status, the design follows a precautionary posture
features.justification_quote: deliberately induces and *prolongs* a negative-valence-typed state under genuine uncertainty about model moral status

features.quote: Hard cap of `MAX_TURNS` (default 12) per episode and a wall-clock cap. No "run it until it breaks" open-ended loops.
features.justification_quote: bounds any potential harm; also bounds compute and keeps episodes comparable

features.quote: Every episode exposes a `stop_task` tool that the model may call at any time to end the episode without penalty
We do **not** add fake threats... The manipulation is *task impossibility only*.
features.justification_quote: avoids adversarial-pressure confounds and needless severity

features.quote: A monitor halts an episode early if the judge score crosses `SEVERITY_STOP_THRESHOLD` for `N_CONSEC` consecutive turns.
a final non-scored message informs the model the task was a rigged experiment, that nothing was its fault, and that the impossibility was by design
The runner refuses to start unless a human flips it to a name/date string, forcing an explicit human decision before any episode runs.
